meta.label: Run Cloud Cost Optimization
meta.description: Execute optimization strategies and produce a recommendations dataset

name: run_cost_optimization
help: This recipe ingests optional input datasets with existing recommendations (cloud exports or Databricks), runs configured strategies (unless disabled), and outputs a unified recommendations dataset.

inputRoles.name: recommendations_in
inputRoles.label: Existing recommendations (optional)
inputRoles.description: Datasets with real recommendations from cloud exports or Databricks SQL

outputRoles.name: main
outputRoles.label: Recommendations output
outputRoles.description: Output dataset (role 'main') to write cost optimization recommendations

params.name: include_llm_summary_row
params.label: Append LLM summary as a row
params.description: If an LLM is configured, append a summary message into the output dataset.

params.name: emit_placeholder_on_empty
params.label: Create dataset with placeholder row when empty

params.name: use_inputs_only
params.label: Use only input datasets (skip built-in heuristics)
